body.message:
I’m really sorry, but I’ve had a very urgent family emergency come up in Iran, and I need to travel back as soon as possible. I’ll most likely return next month.

Would it be possible to hand the apartment back for now and then stay for 28 days starting next month instead?

If this weren’t an emergency, I honestly wouldn’t ask. I truly love this place it’s beautiful and I was really looking forward to staying here.

Thank you so much for your understanding.
